newsitem.title: POLAND: SAMSUNG MULLS BUYING POLISH PLANT.
newsitem.headline: SAMSUNG MULLS BUYING POLISH PLANT.

text.p: A Polish unit of South Korea's Samsung Electronics may build a factory in Poland or buy an existing plant, the unit's general director Jang Jae Lee said on Tuesday.
"We are considering constructing a factory in Poland or buying shares of an existing enterpise," Lee, of Samsung Polska, told Reuters. He declined to give more details.
Lee said that Samsung, which has invested $10 million in Poland since launching operations in the country early last year, planned to double turnover in 1997 to about $100 million.
